name: Form
purpose: Groups input fields and submits them with a consistent action area.
scenarios: Collect feedback with a submit button

submitLabel.description: Accessible label for the submit action.

antiPatterns: Do not use the form only for layout; use Stack for that.
Do not suppress the submit event without providing an alternative submit control.

keyboard: Enter submits from a native input
a11y.focus: Focus follows the document order through fields and the submit button.
a11y.labeling: Form fields provide their own labels; the submit button is labelled by submitLabel.

responsive.strategy: Fields and actions stack vertically; on wider screens the action area aligns to the start.

breakpoints.compact: Fields and submit button use the full inline size.
breakpoints.medium: Fields keep their natural width; actions align to the start.
breakpoints.large: Fields keep their natural width; actions align to the start.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. The action area aligns to the inline start.

mechanics: Form groups fields and a submit action. onSubmit receives the native submit event; preventDefault in SPA handlers. submitLabel names the submit button. Children are the fields. The action area stacks on compact and aligns to inline-start on wider containers.
usage: Import Form and field components from @chameleon-ui/components.
Pass submitLabel and onSubmit. Put Input, Select, and similar controls in children.
Let the Form submit button remain; do not hide it without another submit control.

exports.name: Form
exports.description: Field group with onSubmit and a labelled submit action.
